cause: Context Pack was frozen before development started.
impact: The line has an evidence-bound starting context.
lesson: Freeze the initial context before changing implementation state.

cause: The default sandbox denied binding the real Unix authority socket, so the consumer baseline could not reach the harness boundary.
impact: The default sandbox run was not valid socket-capable evidence; the identical baseline was rerun in the controlled host.
lesson: Keep Unix authority socket permission failures separate from harness RED/GREEN evidence and use a socket-capable host for this boundary.

cause: The direct Unix socket probe closed the shared authority listener and the cached harness returned the missing socket instead of rebuilding a live external server.
impact: A consumer that follows an authority-mount or full-suite socket close fails at client.connect before obtaining external authority.
lesson: Test authority acquisition must validate endpoint path, owner process and server liveness, then rebuild the external Unix server when the cached instance is stale.

cause: The evidence report package seeded the shared test authority, central mount replaced and closed the same pathname, and consumer projection reused the now-unlinked cached server.
impact: The ordered suite completed 87 tests and then produced 21 consumer authority connection failures before projection assertions ran.
lesson: A central mount may replace a shared Unix pathname; every consumer authority acquisition must verify the cached endpoint and rebuild before client connection.

cause: The stale endpoint regression, evidence envelope suite, consumer suite, and central mount plus consumer order completed after the harness liveness rebuild.
impact: The focused host run passed 96 envelope tests, 37 central plus consumer tests, and 31 consumer-only tests; the ordered report-to-central-to-consumer reproduction passed 108 tests.
lesson: Keep consumer authority acquisition as a real Unix-socket gate and exercise both standalone and suite-order paths after socket replacement.

cause: The implementation review compared the scoped diff and confirmed that the authority behavior change is confined to the test server liveness and rebuild harness.
impact: Production evidence code remains unchanged; no in-process or caller-owned authority fallback was introduced.
lesson: Keep test authority transport and production authority ownership separate, and review the allowed-path diff before closing the line.

cause: The scoped line does not execute the full backend regression or production provider and deployment-host acceptance gates.
impact: Package-local consumer harness evidence is complete; full backend, provider, deployment-host and release acceptance remain separate gates.
lesson: Report focused harness verification separately from full backend, provider, host and release acceptance.

cause: The scoped external consumer authority harness repair and its focused verification are complete.
impact: The line hands off a live-external-authority test harness with explicit standalone, order-dependent and envelope regression evidence.
lesson: Complete a scoped line only after RED/GREEN evidence, formal integrity and external acceptance boundaries are separately recorded.
